captions.text: This is a wholesale fund in Australia. Its investors hold units on a register.
lines: This is a wholesale fund in Australia.
Its investors hold units on a register.

captions.text: How does it become a token on Redbelly?
lines: How does it become a token on Redbelly?

captions.text: Today, registers sit across separate systems,
checks are manual, and settlement takes days.
Step one. A legal review confirms the trust deed allows ownership on chain.
lines: Step one. A legal review confirms the
trust deed allows ownership on chain.

captions.text: The manager's existing licence covers it. There is no separate tokenisation licence.
lines: The manager's existing licence covers it.
There is no separate tokenisation licence.

captions.text: Step two. On Tokeniser, the manager sets the rules:
who can invest, foreign ownership limits, lock-up periods.
They are written into the token itself.
lines: They are written into the token itself.

captions.text: Step three. Each investor is verified: identity,
anti-money laundering screening, investor classification.
Until then, no tokens can reach their wallet.
Step four. Tokens for their units are issued on Redbelly Network,
lines: Step four. Tokens for their units

captions.text: into verified wallets.
The register is live from the first token.
lines: The register is live from the first token.

captions.text: Step five. Every transfer is checked against those rules first.
Break a rule, and it is rejected.
lines: Break a rule, and it is rejected.

captions.text: Pass, and it settles in seconds.
lines: Pass, and it settles in seconds.

captions.text: Underneath is Redbelly Network,
Australia's public digital token infrastructure.
Every participant's identity is verified at protocol level,
and confirmed transactions cannot be reversed.
Its consensus is formally verified.
And Australia's central bank chose Redbelly for Project Acacia.
Same fund. Same strategy. Same licence.
lines: Same fund. Same strategy. Same licence.

captions.text: Now its units are compliant tokens on Redbelly, through Tokeniser.
lines: Now its units are compliant tokens
